title: Characterization of T-cell Repertoire in Patients With Acute Myeloid Leukemia Undergoing Donor Stem Cell Transplant
official: Characterization of T-cell Repertoire in Patients With AML Undergoing HSCT Through Next-Generation Sequencing of T Cell Receptor Alpha (TCRA) and T Cell Receptor Beta (TCRB) Genes
summary: This research trial studies characterization of T-cell repertoire through next-generation sequencing in patients with acute myeloid leukemia undergoing stem cell transplant. Characterizing T-cell repertoire may help to understand if immune system plays a significant role in high risk patients with acute myeloid leukemia.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of AML scheduled to undergo HSCT at University of Southern California (USC)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to provide consent because of severe mental disorders
* Donor unwilling to provide consent
